races.paceDynamic: Deedaydiva emerges as the sole confirmed front runner in this field of 13 fillies, with supporting prominent runners Eskimo Pie, Brighlee and Tashi Delek unlikely to challenge for the early lead given their preferred positions. This creates a sustainable pace scenario where Deedaydiva can dictate terms without pressure, particularly over this stamina-testing 1m2½f trip at Nottingham. The relatively soft early pace will favor horses that can travel kindly and produce a finishing kick. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners and hold-up horses with a proven turn of foot, as they can position perfectly behind the uncontested leader before striking in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Deedaydiva gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too soft for closers to make up ground, allowing the front runner to control the race from pillar to post. Deedaydiva's proven form at this distance combined with the tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the experienced prominent runners can sit perfect second behind Deedaydiva and outkick her
scenarios.body: Eskimo Pie or Brighlee travel smoothly in behind the leader before producing superior acceleration in the final furlong. Their race fitness and proven ability at similar distances gives them the edge over the uncontested front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Botagoz or one of the newcomers produces a sweeping late run that catches the early leaders in the dying strides. The stamina-sapping nature of Nottingham's finish suits horses with a strong turn of foot held up for one decisive effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced fillies from top connections shows significant improvement from their debut runs
scenarios.body: A well-bred newcomer from Beckett, Dunlop or Haggas stables demonstrates the ability that warranted their entry in this conditions race. Their fresher condition and untapped potential allows them to quicken past more exposed rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Frantic stands as the sole confirmed front-runner in this maiden fillies' contest, likely to dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. The prominent runners Egotistical may track closely, but with five hold-up horses including the experienced Hen Party and improving Mehmas Engine, this shapes as a race where the pace can build steadily. The majority of the field will be looking to come from off the pace, creating potential traffic problems in the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours horses that can secure good early positions and avoid the inevitable late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Frantic Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Frantic gets an easy lead without early pressure from Egotistical
scenarios.body: She can dictate a steady pace that suits her stamina reserves, making life difficult for the hold-up brigade who need a strong gallop. Her proven form at this trip gives her every chance to resist late challengers who leave themselves too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Delivers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run and the hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: The backmarkers can unleash their finishing kicks with Hen Party's consistent 6f form and Mehmas Engine's recent sharpness coming to the fore. This scenario requires both a strong pace and luck in running for multiple horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomers Exploit Experience Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced fillies shows significant improvement from their debuts
scenarios.body: Sweet Desire with Silvestre De Sousa or Elshie under Jane Chapple-Hyam could have been well-schooled at home and ready to make their mark. The maiden nature of this contest leaves room for unexposed improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos Benefits Patient
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems and interference plague the finish in a bunched field
scenarios.body: A horse like Bintaryana, despite her modest rating, could sneak through late gaps while others are stopped in their tracks. Patient jockeyship becomes crucial when multiple horses converge in the final furlong.

races.paceDynamic: Seven Of Hearts, I'm Dan Dare, and Takincareofbizness will blast off from the gates creating a fierce early gallop over this minimum trip. With three confirmed leaders in a 17-runner sprint handicap, the pace will be genuinely strong and likely unsustainable. The strong gallop will stretch the field and test stamina reserves even at 5f, with the front three likely to weaken in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fast - the pace will set up perfectly for closers to sweep up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and fade
scenarios.body: The strong pace will perfectly set up the closers who can stay on when the pace-setters weaken. Horses like Hellcat, Faithful Dream, and Mereside Spark can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one horse can sit just off the pace without getting drawn in
scenarios.body: A prominent runner can avoid the early burn-up while staying close enough to strike. Staniel Cay or Rosieisme Darling could get the perfect position behind the battling leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets an easier time than expected and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: Seven Of Hearts might get a softer lead if the other two pace-setters don't fire. With good tactical riding, a front runner could just hold on over this minimum distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go impossibly fast and completely collapse
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes so fierce that even the closers struggle with the stop-start nature. A mid-division horse could sneak through when everything falls apart late.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Brazen looks the only confirmed front runner in this field and should dictate terms from the start without serious pressure. With most runners holding prominent/pressing positions (Level Up, Papa Don't Preach, High Opinion, Initial Blue, Jeany May), they'll track Miss Brazen in a cluster behind the leader rather than applying early heat. The pace will be sustainable rather than frantic over this minimum trip, with the real action coming in the final two furlongs when the prominent runners fan out to challenge. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early, as hold-up horses Winchurch and Scent Of May will struggle to pick up the pieces from the rear in a race lacking genuine early speed.

scenarios.trigger: If Miss Brazen gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to resist the late challengers who've given her too much rope. The lack of early pace plays perfectly into her hands as a front runner returning from a break.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Presser Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get close enough to Miss Brazen without using too much energy
scenarios.body: Initial Blue or Level Up can strike from their forward positions when Miss Brazen begins to tire in the final furlong. Their handy positions allow them to quicken without needing a clear run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Picks Up
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple horses pressuring Miss Brazen early
scenarios.body: Winchurch can benefit from a stronger tempo that sets up his hold-up style, picking off tired leaders. His recent third over six furlongs suggests he's in good form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy scramble with multiple horses vying for the lead
scenarios.body: Papa Don't Preach's recent win and good form could see him outbattle rivals in a tactical affair where his versatility helps. His lower weight becomes an asset in a slowly-run sprint.

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning matters more than pure pace, creating a scramble where any style can prevail depending on racing luck. The winner emerges from chaos rather than tactics.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: James Park Woods is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the gate, setting what should be a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The entire field apart from James Park Woods shows hold-up tendencies, creating a tactical race where the pace-setter could steal a march if allowed easy fractions. This will become a waiting game behind James Park Woods until the home turn, when the hold-up brigade will need to produce their finishing kicks simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the early leader James Park Woods and any hold-up horses with proven tactical speed who can overcome traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If James Park Woods secures uncontested fractions and builds a decisive advantage turning for home.
scenarios.body: The veteran will have too much rope and his recent Kempton win shows he retains enough ability to hold determined finishers. Hold-up horses face a wall of traffic in the straight as they all come with runs together.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too slow and one hold-up horse produces a devastating late surge.
scenarios.body: James Park Woods will tie up in the final furlong after dictating terms, allowing the strongest stayer to power through. Desiderata's recent form and Havlin's booking suggests connections expect a big run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates serious interference problems in the home straight.
scenarios.body: Several horses will find their runs blocked or delayed, gifting the race to those who secure clear runs or avoid the scrimmaging entirely. James Park Woods could benefit from the mayhem behind him.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform and a lightly-raced improver strikes.
scenarios.body: The long absence and handicap mark adjustments could see one of the less exposed runners outrun their odds significantly. Fresh horses often thrive in these competitive handicaps.

watchPoints.text: James Park Woods must be monitored for early pace - if he secures soft fractions he becomes extremely dangerous
Traffic problems are inevitable with nine hold-up horses converging simultaneously in the home straight
Desiderata's market support despite 24-day break suggests stable intelligence of a big performance
First-time headgear on Charencey and Haaf A Diamond could spark improvement but both face fitness concerns
The 5lb and 3lb claiming jockeys on Clipsham Noble and Raysham respectively provide significant weight advantages
